title: Atlas Idea Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of an Atlas idea (ideen/*.md). v2 (ADR-0004, issue #46): statuses simplify to seed -> developing -> promoted -> parked; drafting/publishing state lives on the Publication. The startup migration maps legacy /1 statuses (drafting -> developing, published -> promoted). Single source of truth (P6).

status.description: seed -> developing -> promoted -> parked. 'promoted' means a Publication was derived from this idea (Promote action); the idea file stays as history (P1).

refs.description: BibTeX citekeys → join to the LocalBib library.

diss.description: IDs of dissertation nodes this idea feeds into.
